images.scene: SCENE: Two men in a plain office at the end of the working day, seen from a low angle. One man sits at a simple wooden desk with a few stacked papers in front of him, shoulders heavy, looking down at the papers. Standing close beside him, leaning slightly in, is an older Asian-Brazilian businessman in a light buttoned dress shirt with the sleeves rolled up, one open hand gesturing toward the papers as he explains something with calm authority. The seated man has turned his head to listen to him. Behind the two of them the room dissolves into pale empty haze.

SCENE: Two men at a plain wooden office desk at the end of the working day. The younger man sits with his hands still on the desk beside a stack of papers, tired, and has turned toward the man next to him. The other is an older Asian-Brazilian businessman in a light buttoned dress shirt with rolled sleeves, seated on the corner of the same desk, leaning toward him, one hand pointing at a figure on the paper, explaining it patiently. Both are lit from a window on the left. Behind them the room dissolves into pale empty haze.

SCENE: An older Asian-Brazilian man in a light buttoned dress shirt with the sleeves rolled up stands at a plain wooden table cleaning a whole fish with a knife, his hands working, head lowered in concentration, a few fish laid out on newspaper beside him. Same plain room, same window light from the left. Behind him the room dissolves into pale empty haze.

SCENE: Two men at a plain wooden office desk at the end of the working day, shot from behind the shoulder of one of them. In the FOREGROUND, seen from BEHIND, an older man in a light buttoned dress shirt with rolled sleeves leans over the desk, his hand pointing at a figure on a sheet of paper. His head is turned away from the camera so his face is NOT visible. Across the desk, facing the camera, a tired younger business owner sits with his hands still on the papers, looking down at where the older man is pointing, listening. Window light from the left. Behind them the room dissolves into pale empty haze.

SCENE: Close view of a worn wooden desk top from a low angle. Two pairs of hands over a handwritten ledger sheet covered in columns of figures. The hands of an older man, weathered and heavy, with rolled light shirt cuffs, reach in from the right and one index finger presses firmly on a single figure in the middle of the page. The younger man's hands rest still and open on the paper beside them, doing nothing. No faces, no heads, only hands and the papers. Window light from the left. Behind the desk the room dissolves into pale empty haze.

SCENE: Close view of a worn wooden desk top from a low angle. A handwritten ledger sheet covered in columns of figures lies open on the desk. The weathered hand of an older man, with a rolled light shirt cuff, reaches in from the right and his index finger presses firmly on one single figure in the middle of the page. Nothing else on the desk but a stub of pencil and a stack of older papers pushed aside. No people, no faces, only the one hand and the papers. Window light from the left. Behind the desk the room dissolves into pale empty haze.
